ai.title: The OpenAI board member who fired Sam Altman says we still can’t trust AI CEOs
ai.brief: CSET’s Helen Toner says ‘we’re screwed’ if our AI safety plan rests on any one person being trusted to get this right. Today, I’m talking with Helen Toner, the executive director of the Center for Security and Emerging Technology at Georgetown University. This episode is part two of our series on AI in real life. Helen is a well-known figure in the AI safety and policy community, though she is perhaps best known for having served on the board of OpenAI, when she was one of four board members who voted to fire Sam Altman . That incident, now sometimes referred to as “the blip,” ended with Sam coming back as CEO, Helen resigning, and a new board of directors. OpenAI has since restructured entirely .

sec.title: Extortion Group Claims Theft of Nearly One Billion Expedia Traveler Records
sec.brief: S. S. 7 million people A newly formed Russian cyber extortion group called n0n claims it has hit Expedia, the world’s second-largest online travel agency, and taken data on nearly one billion travelers. Expedia confirmed to Skift on Thursday that attackers had breached its systems through a third-party data platform provider in a supply chain attack that also affected other companies. ” reported the website Skift. “Acknowledgment came after several cybersecurity sites reported this week on allegations by an extortion group known as n0n that it had stolen Expedia data. “
